trips.name: Golden Circle (Þingvellir, Geysir, Gullfoss)
trips.description: The classic standard organized bus tour loops through Þingvellir National Park, the Geysir geothermal area and the huge Gullfoss waterfall.

trips.name: Blue Lagoon
trips.description: Regular scheduled buses run from Reykjavik's BSÍ terminal to this geothermal spa on the Reykjanes Peninsula (booking ahead is required).

trips.name: South Coast (Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss, Reynisfjara)
trips.description: A full-day organized coach tour to the south coast's waterfalls and the black sand beach at Reynisfjara near Vík.
